Subject: Renewal coming up — need new private environment + isolation at term rollover

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you had a good weekend. Our contract with Redwood is up for renewal on 2027-04-30 and we want to take the next term to move two critical workloads into a separate private environment. High level asks:

- Add a second private cluster (EU region) dedicated to PCI-adjacent workloads with strict VPC isolation.
- Keep one cluster for analytics + public-facing inference.
- Term: we are evaluating a 24-month commit but need pricing for both 12- and 24-month options.
- Data residency and audit logs mandatory; SOC2 evidence already provided last year but we will need retention/retention windows clarified.

I attached a short doc with proposed dates and our network team’s initial requirements. Can we start a technical + commercial sync this week? Prefer afternoons CET.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena — thanks for the note and the PDF. This is straightforward but there are a few coordination points we should lock down up front:

1) Scope: we will provision a second VPC-hosted private environment in eu-west-1 and set up network peering + strict route controls so there is no cross-VPC traffic between the new PCI-adjacent cluster and your analytics cluster.
2) Capacity: propose 2x additional GPU nodes initially (we can autoscale); please confirm expected qps and peak seq len.
3) Term/pricing: I’ll pull 12/24 month quotes for both Reserved Dedicated clusters and a mixed dedic+burst option.
4) Timeline: proposed provisioning start is 2027-04-04 with production cutover on 2027-04-28 to align with your term rollover.

I’ve attached a short preliminary scope workbook so we can capture the numbers before the sync. Can Priyom join the technical call and Neha loop in procurement? Availability: Wed 16 Mar 14:00–16:00 CET or Thu 17 Mar 09:00–11:00 CET.

Best,

Elena / team — quick technical checklist ahead of the call so we can size the clusters properly: (I’ll paste this into the meeting notes too)

- Expected sustained QPS per service (p95): request numbers for model A (inference) and model B (batch embeddings).
- Typical prompt/response token distribution and 99th percentile sequence lengths.
- Do you require HSM/KMS separation for the PCI env? If yes, which provider (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS / other)?
- Network: will ClearPath initiate a VPN or use direct connect / private link? We support both; if you need our side of the subnet ranges we can provide them in the next message.
- Audit logs: retention target (90/180/365 days) and whether logs must be exported to your Splunk/SIEM.

A couple of notes from our side: if you pick a 24-month reserved term we can include 10% off list for the second dedicated cluster and offer an expedited provisioning SLA for the EU cluster (3-week turnaround). If you need full air-gap for PCI we’ll need a slightly longer lead time and a written change to the SOW.

Cheers,
Priyom

Thanks — quick answers inline:

- Sustained QPS: Model A (customer-facing inference): 120 qps p95 steady, spikes to ~320 qps p99. Model B (embeddings): 30 qps p95.
- Token lengths: median 320 tokens, p99 ~2,100 tokens for a small subset of long chat histories.
- KMS: yes — we require AWS KMS with a separate CMK for the PCI env; we manage the CMK.
- Network: we plan to use Direct Connect from our colo to the Redwood VPC; we’ll need the target /28 ranges for the initial setup.
- Audit logs: retention 365 days; export to our Splunk instance (details in network-requirements.pdf).

Procurement note: attaching a draft PO and our standard procurement terms for SOW-based work. We expect pricing options for 12 vs 24 months; Lisa from procurement is on copy.

Elena / Lisa / team — thanks for the fast responses. Quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth before you issue the PO: 

Summary of agreement:
- Provision a second private environment in eu-west-1 with strict VPC isolation and independent CMK (AWS KMS) as requested.
- Initial topology: 2 dedicated GPU nodes (n1-standard equivalents) + autoscale to 6 nodes for peak traffic; we will revisit sizing after 30 days of telemetry.
- Audit log retention configured to 365 days and forwarded to your Splunk endpoint.
- Term options: 12-month list pricing provided in SOW; 24-month committed pricing includes a 10% discount on the second cluster and an expedited EU provisioning SLA (3 weeks).
- Cutover window: provisioning begins 2027-04-04; production cutover targeted for 2027-04-28 to align with contract rollover.

Attachments included in this email: SOW_ClearPath_v2.pdf (SOW with line items and pricing), cluster-topology-sketch.png (ops diagram). Please review the SOW and mark any redlines; if procurement is comfortable we can proceed with a DocuSign SOW + PO flow.

Next actions:
1) Vanessa to send formal SOW and pricing (attached).
2) ClearPath procurement to confirm PO + preferred signature flow (DocuSign or emailed PO).
3) Priyom and Dylan to receive Direct Connect info and provide /28 ranges by 2027-03-22.

If that all looks good I’ll generate a DocuSign envelope for the 24-month SOW and share pricing options inline. Thanks all — we’ll treat this as high priority to meet your cutover date.
